skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK (+10) damage to a single target. On a critical hit, has a 100% chance to inflict [Corrosion] on the main target for 2 turns (15% ATK as DoT).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 27% ATK (+3) damage to all enemies in 3 hit combos, with a 100% chance to inflict [Injured] on the main target for 2 turns (when attacked, adds Injury damage equal to 50% ATK).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 27% ATK (+3) damage to all enemies in 3 hit combos, with a 100% chance to inflict [Injured] on the main target and a 50% chance to inflict it on the main target's row for 2 turns (when attacked, adds Injury damage equal to 50% ATK).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by (+20). Inflicts [Weaken] on enemies afflicted with [Injured] (ATK reduced by 20% for 1 turn).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by (+20). Inflicts [Weaken] on enemies afflicted with [Injured] (ATK reduced by 30% for 1 turn).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by (+20). Inflicts [Weaken] on enemies afflicted with [Injured] (ATK reduced by 35% for 1 turn).

effects.desc: Unfavorable effect reduces the target's damage reduction rate by 30% for the duration.
Corrosive damage over time effect, each turn dealing damage equal to a percentage of ST (e.g. 300%) to the target.
